data_sources: bergsteigen.com (Civetta, Nasenwand, Turm jenseits des Tales, Don Bosco Grat, Donna Rossa, Wachauergrat, Kummerstalturm, Dürnstein bei der Burgruine)

metadata.notes: Duplicate GPX waypoints merged into the entry with the most data. 84 unique sector locations (83 in main sector arrays + 1 extra sector), no duplicates. Empty fields are ready for future updates.

region_info.name: Dürnstein / Wachau
region_info.description: Oldest developed climbing area in the Wachau valley. Gneiss rock, slab (Platten) and edge (Leisten) climbing. Towers and walls with mostly short routes, sport and trad. Dürnstein crag has 291 routes (theCrag), grades 1- to 9 (UIAA).
region_info.approach: From Krems on B3 (Danube federal road) to Dürnstein. Parking: Dürnstein P8 ~450 m west of Dürnstein (3 houses, 6 spots, pay machine) or Dürnstein railway station (fee). From the station cross the railway tracks and follow the paved path into the gully (5-10 min to first rocks, Schwarzer Turm).
region_info.parking: P8 west of Dürnstein (48.4036, 15.5154, 209 m) or Dürnstein Bahnhof (209 m). Note: 'Halten und Parken verboten' signs reported in some areas (photo 2021).
region_info.public_transport: Train or ship to Dürnstein, then on foot.
region_info.rock_character: Plattig (slab) or Leistenkletterei (edge climbing), some steep/overhanging routes.
region_info.gear: 40-70 m rope (recommend 70 m at Civetta/Nasenwand), 10-15 quickdraws, helmet, slings for belays (trad routes).
region_info.exposure: All orientations, tendentially South and West.
region_info.season: Year-round possible at Dürnstein (towers have routes on all sides); fog in autumn. Nasenwand ideal spring/autumn, too hot in summer. Kummerstalturm in shade most of the day - good for hot days.
region_info.restrictions: Kummerstal area: climbing only 09:00-17:00, no climbing 15.07.-14.08. (bird protection). Verify current rules.
region_info.child_friendly: Dürnstein bei der Burgruine: yes. Kummerstalturm: yes. Nasenwand/Civetta: no.

areas.name: Masyw główny Dürnstein (Dürnstein main massif)
areas.description: Core of the region: 27+ towers and walls in a ~230 x 360 m field. Distances between sectors 20-30 m - a full day without changing base.
areas.sun_2026_03_20: 6.2 to 10.8 h. Longest: Mittlerer Sägezahn (06:10-16:50). Shortest: Turm der Mächtigen (12:00-18:00).

sectors.name: Däumling
sectors.notes: Most prominent tower, hardest routes in Dürnstein. Classics: Däumling Nordostkante 6★★, Däumling Südost Riss 6+★★.

sectors.style: part of Omas Kegel und Fratzofels (theCrag)

sectors.name: Edelweissturm (Edelweißturm)
sectors.notes: Most prominent tower next to Däumling. Elevation ~390 m estimated (between Dreifingerspitze 396 and Turm der Schmächtigen 363).

sectors.name: Abendlichtplatte (Platte des späten Abendlichts)
sectors.notes: Route: Platte des Späten Abendlichts 4★★ (theCrag Spiegel area).

sectors.name: Spiegel / Spiegel und umliegende Felsen
sectors.notes: Smooth ~15 m slab, plate climbing. Surrounding rocks: Flammenplatte, Platte des Späten Abendlichts, Sitting Bull, Sinowatzfels, Hexer. Routes: Kleiner Spiegel 2+★★ (7m), Direkter Spiegel 5+★★ (15m), Seitenspiegel/Känguruh 3+★★ (10m), Spiegel 4★★, Die Wange des Hexers 4★★.

sectors.name: Großer Adlerfelsen

sectors.name: Narrenturm (Dürnstein)
sectors.notes: theCrag sector within Dürnstein massif (sector #27). Classic: Narrenturmkante 4+★★★. Distinct from Narrenturm near Weißenkirchen (GPX).

areas.name: Sektory północne / od strony doliny (North sectors, valley side)
areas.description: Sectors on the valley side, more widely spaced (30-85 m). Good option for a second day or when the main massif is crowded.
areas.sun_2026_03_20: 7.3 to 12.0 h. Longest: Piratalwand (06:10-18:00). Shortest: Turm jenseits des Tales (06:10-13:20).

sectors.name: Nasenwand
sectors.grade_range: 4+ to 10- (bergsteigen); theCrag: 107 routes, 235-342 m, sub-sectors Upper 12 / Central 39 / Lower 33 / Deeper 23
sectors.notes: One of the best crags in the Wachau, perfect view of Dürnstein/Danube, some road noise. Approach 15 min, entry 250 m. Spring/autumn ideal, summer hot (climb before 13:00). Not child friendly. Caution: hollow blocks marked on topo. 70 m rope, 15 quickdraws. Classics: Der Weg ist das Ziel 6★★, Nick Neck 6+/7-★★★, Atacama 2SL 7+★★★.

sectors.name: Civetta
sectors.notes: Tower-like formation, routes up to 3 pitches, mostly steep/overhanging. Gföhler Gneis. Sun 9-15 h, in shade after 15:00. Rain-sensitive but dries fast. Approach 10 min, entry 250 m. 70 m rope, 15 quickdraws. Not child friendly.

sectors.name: Turm jenseits des Tales (Wand jenseits des Tales)
sectors.notes: Plaisir routes, 10 pitches developed in this area (3 short). Up to 4 pitches. Entry 300 m, approach 15 min. 50 m rope, 10 quickdraws, slings. Routes: Just married 4SL (6/5+/6/6-), Mariakante 2SL (6+/6), Dreimäderlhaus 3SL (5+/6-/4+), Via Anna-Sophie 2SL (6-/7-), Wachau plaisir 2SL (5/6+), Plaisir light 1SL (5+), Fiameskante 3SL (trad, no bolts). Shade from 15:00.

sectors.name: Wächterwand
sectors.notes: GPX only - no additional data yet.

sectors.name: Kummerstalturm
sectors.notes: Small crag hidden in forest at the foot of Don Bosco Grat (near parking 48.4036, 15.5154, entry 230 m). In shade most of the day - good for hot days. Child friendly. Approach 15 min. 20 named routes (see routes section).

areas.name: Grupa Wachauergrat (grzbiet północny, north ridge)
areas.description: Highest group, longest approach. Ridge and crest formations. Long multi-pitch routes.
areas.sun_2026_03_20: 10.8 to 12.0 h. Longest: Ruck-Zuck Wandl (06:10-18:00). Shortest: Wachauergrat (07:20-18:00).

sectors.name: Wachauergrat (Wachauer Grat)
sectors.notes: One of the best routes in Eastern Austria. 350 m climbing, 17 pitches, exits possible anytime (towers). FA P. Dunst & J. Brandl 11.3.2001. Approach 15 min, entry 300 m, descent 30 min (Dürnsteiner Kanzel 512 m). 50 m rope, 12 quickdraws, sling, helmet. Restriction: Kummerstal climbing 09:00-17:00, no climbing 15.07.-14.08.

sectors.name: Don-Bosco-Grat (oberer Punkt)
sectors.notes: Younger, renovated classic. Steep chimney start, two Elbsandstein overhangs. Follows blue dots, Bühler haken; copper plaques mark Donna Rossa. FA Erich Weiermayer 11.4.2001. 290 m/300 Hm, 3:00-3:45 h. 50 m rope, 7 quickdraws, slings, mid-size cams, KK set. Entry 300 m. Descent via Dürnsteiner Kanzel.

sectors.name: Don-Bosco-Grat (niższy punkt)
sectors.notes: Second GPX waypoint of the same ridge at 422 m.

sectors.name: Donna Rossa
sectors.notes: New plaisir route parallel to Don Bosco Grat, very well bolted, marked with copper plaques. 300 m/300 Hm, 3:00-3:45 h. 50 m rope, 11 quickdraws, slings, helmet. Entry 300 m (start via Don Bosco Grat pitches). FA info 2020.

extra_sectors.name: Smaragdlerweg
extra_sectors.notes: Longest route in Dürnstein: 19 pitches, 450 m/300 Hm. theCrag sector with 19 routes. Classic: 9. SL - Smaragdlerweg 2+★★★. Coordinates from theCrag (2026-08-02, fallback = parent area).

areas.name: Willendorf / Hoher Stein
